caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure on a rectangular black plinth. The figure is dressed in tan-colored clothing, consisting of a long-sleeved tunic with fringe at the hem, matching pants with side fringe, and tan shoes. A wide red sash is tied around the waist, with a long end hanging down on the right side. The figure’s left arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand open and holding a small, indistinguishable object. The skin is a reddish-brown tone, and the face has black hair with two side braids, the ends of which are tied and rest on the chest. The figure wears a tan cap with a horizontal band near the edge. The drawing is set against a plain, light background, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature "Cordena Jackson" is located at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
